offering_description.value: Designs, installs and services HVAC, plumbing, piping, electrical and building control systems for commercial, industrial and institutional facilities. Its operating companies deliver projects through on-site construction and off-site fabrication, and provide ongoing maintenance, repair and replacement.

primary_products.value: prefabricated mechanical and electrical modules; piping assemblies; modular equipment rooms

primary_services.value: mechanical and electrical design-build; HVAC, plumbing and electrical installation; off-site fabrication; preventive maintenance and repair; system retrofit and replacement

customer_segment.value: B2B: General contractors, data center operators, manufacturers, commercial property owners and private institutions; B2G: Public agencies and school districts procuring facility construction or upgrades

end_markets.value: data centers; industrial manufacturing; commercial real estate; healthcare; education and public facilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Design, fabrication, installation and replacement of mechanical and electrical systems; service fees: Preventive maintenance agreements, repairs and service calls

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses skilled trades, engineering and purchased equipment to build and maintain systems for contractors and facility owners; OEM / manufacturer: Assembles purchased equipment and materials into prefabricated modules for construction customers

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across multiple regions of the United States

specialization.value: related lines: HVAC, plumbing, process piping, electrical systems, building controls, modular fabrication and facility maintenance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Regional operating companies bid directly to facility owners and general contractors and sell service agreements to building operators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State and local trade contractor licensing, building permits and codes, and OSHA construction safety rules

notes: Prefabricated systems are delivered under project contracts, and the extent of stand-alone product sales is unclear.
